batting.name: DA Miller
batting.dismissal: c AM Rahane b KK Cooper

batting.name: MS Gony
batting.dismissal: c SV Samson b JP Faulkner

balls.text: yorker length delivery that's swinging into the batsman and he can only get some bat on it, single to the leg side
short of length and slower too, he wanted to pull it away but does not get any bat on it, they are still away for a single
outside the off stump and very full, he goes for a lofted off drive and hits it straight up and to the fielder at deep extra-cover
wide, wide outside the off stump, that was full but no way could the batsman have got close to it
short of length and on his pads, easily flicked away to backward square-leg for a couple of runs
on his pads and quicker, flicks it away to fine-leg for a single
slower one, rolls his fingers over the ball and he's able to hit it through extra-cover

and that's gone again, Miller's innings is a short one! it was a slower one and he looks to pull it away, in fact he was looking to smoke it away on the leg side but never reached the pitch of the bat, hits it straight to deep mid-wicket and easily taken by Rahane
fuller on the middle stump, not too slow this and he's pushed it to the long-on area for a single

and now he's bowled off a slower one! does not give too much pace on it, does not pitch it up either which means that he's got to make his own pace, he tries to do that by hitting it across the line, misses and the top of the middle stump is rattled
shorter one and he's rolled his fingers over it, it reaches the batsman tomorrow, he taps it to to the leg side
goes down the track and wants to whack it away, not too much pace on the ball and he's beaten, bounces twice before getting to the keeper
shorter in length and pulled straight to the deep square-leg fielder for a single
full-toss and he can only push it to the deep mid-wicket for a single, good over in the circumstance by Watto
full-toss on the off stump, it was right in his slot and he can only drill it down to long-off for a single
punched on the up and it's gone in the same region as the previous one, easily taken couple of runs for Miller
wide outside the off stump, in fact wide enough to be called one had he left it, but he does not, goes after it and hits it through to deep extra-cover for a couple
full-toss on his pads and he's missed it! was looking to flick it away and gets no bat on on it, runs over to the off side for a leg-bye
goes for a big hit, slower one that and he is too early in his shot, beaten
and now again, beats the full-bloodied cut shot and it's gone in the air and fallen just short of the fielder at deep cover
and now he's dropped! Dravid's dropped a relatively simple catch, he was looking to loft it over the off side but gets the toe of the bat, goes high and through Dravid's hands in the covers
goes for a big heave across the line but does not connect properly and it's run away to backward square-leg for a couple
on his pads and flicked away to the deep square-leg for a single
slower one, on a length and he has to quickly adapt to it, taps it in front of him and the bowler runs over to prevent the single
full on the middle stump and he drives it down to long-off for a single
slower one and shorter in length, easily tapped away to retain strike
outside the off and that's drilled through the covers for a four, that's Marsh coming into his own after a relatively slow start
fuller and swinging back into the left-hander, driven down to long-on for a single
shorter in length immediately, tapped away to the off side for a single
and now he's hit it over long-on for a six! fuller and right into his slot, he's cracked it over long-on for a biggie!
yorker length ball and unless I am seeing things, there's a definite case of some reverse back into the batsman, digs it out
short of length and that's pulled away hard and straight to the deep square-leg fielder for a single
on his pads and he flicks it to the leg side, bit of swing back into him and hits the pads, rolls over to the on-side for a leg-bye
fuller on the off stump, no room and he drives it back, in the V and to the mid-off fielder

bowled him, was that reverse swing? it was fuller in length and Hussey was looking to go down the track and flick it over the leg side, but the ball swings back into him and he misses it completely, bowled!
on his pads, on a length too and tapped to the short mid-wicket fielder
fuller on the off stump and he's hit it down the ground, driven straight to long-off for a single
fuller on the off stump and all he can do is to pat it down to long-on for a single
slower one and it's tapped back to the bowler, taking the pace off it is making it difficult for the batsmen
on the middle stump and on a good length, he's back and flicking to the leg side for a single
catch it, yes he does! gone, caught and bowled! slower one and he was looking to play it through the off side but has to check his stroke, only managing to lob it back to the bowler, easily caught
tries to bludgeon it away and hits it straight too but without too much power and they don't get back for the second
lofts him but not off the middle either, no timing there and it lobs up to mid-wicket for a signel
outside the off stump and wants to cut it away, misses
very straight and full and easily tucked away through fine-leg for a four, beats the fielder inside the circle to get to his 50, well played!
on his pads and there's a fielder close in on the leg side, they don't get a single
flicked away to the leg side for a couple of runs
and it's a similar delivery, same line and length, and he goes down the track and hits it down to long-on for a single
on his pads and very full, surprisingly, he was looking to play it to the off side, and misses
on his pads and he wants to flick it, gets no bat on it but runs away to the fine-leg fence off his pads
swings because that's in his arc, unfortunately it does not go into the park, just bounces off gently to the fielder at deep square-leg for a single
opens the face of the bat and runs it down to third-man for a single
that's shorter one but he's cleverly held his pace back, he goes for a pull but it does not go where he intended, runs over to long-on for a single
short of length and slower, wants to unwind and cut it away, hits it straight to the fielder
slapped and through the covers but straight to the fielder, it was fuller and outside the off and hit well but does not find the gap
on his pads and tucked away to the leg side for another couple of runs
very outside the off and on a good length, he was looking to cut it again but bit of a bottom edge that runs away to the off side, where the short cover fielder fields
tries to cut it away and the top edge goes over the the keeper's gloves, he was up to the stumps and that's beaten him
now goes down the track to smack it away but the slowness of the delivery, and probably of the pitch, makes him mistime the stroke, rolls over to long-on for a single
fuller on his pads and tapped back to the bowler, he fails to latch on to it and they take a single
short of length and spanked! he was looking to pull it and he does it quite well there, beats the two fielders there and runs away to the fence
yorker length, quicker too, dug out by the batsman and pushed across for a single
on his pads, short of length and he does not get any bat on it, could well have been tucked down to the fine-leg fence for a four, instead he will have to re-bowl that one
fuller on the off stump and he's still playing them off the back foot, drives it down to long-off for a single
slower on his pads, and he easily tucks it to short fine-leg for a single
driven through the covers for a single
caressed! it was short and wide from the bowler and easily carved through the backward point, Sreesanth at third-man runs to his left and dives well, parries it across for a couple
bit of movement back into the batsman, he opens the face and tapped away to the off side for a single
outside the off stump, very wide outside and he's let it go through, given a wide, not a good start for Cooper after conceding that misfield earlier
fuller on the middle stump and driven down to long-off for a single
finally off the middle of the bat and for a four, the point fielder was backward and that's gone in the gap, was short and wide and he gets it right this time
short of length delivery and that's tucked to the leg side for a single
the ball does not come on to the bat, he was looking to swing it away but gets no part of the middle, rushes to long-on for a single
on his pads, it's an offie bowled by him and he wants to flick it away, misses the bat and hits his pads, not for runs though
fuller on the middle stump and he wants to guide it away through to third-man, opens the face of the bat too, but it goes to the point fielder
it's outside the off stump and he wants to cut it away, does not get it off the middle and it goes so slowly to the point fielder that they are able to get going for a single
closer to the body this time and tucked away to the leg side for a single

on a good length and outside the off stump, he had a bit of room to free his arms and he does just that, gets the outside half of the bat and flies over the top, Cooper gives a good chase to his right but makes an absolute mess of it at the fence
shorter in length and he's on the back foot, pushing it away to the off side
shorter in length and very close to the stumps, he was on the back foot and taps it back to the bowler
edged and gone very fine to third-man for a single, that was on a length and almost squared him up
tapped away to the off side but again to the fielder
wants to cut it away, misses, bit of an appeal from the keeper before he shuts up, probably realises it had missed the edge, probably was apprehensive of another dose of Gilly's anger
poor effort in the field by Sreesanth, it was a shorter one and cut, Sreesanth at the backward point dives it an hour before he should have, it sneaks through
and again, that's the second lofted shot, straight back over the bowler's head, this time it's bounced and gone away for a four, finally getting them off the middle of the bat now
goes down the track and smacks it over for a six, uses his feet well against Chandila and gets it off the middle of the bat, smacked
round the stumps, outside the off stump and tapped to the off side for a quickly taken single
cuts it hard and well too but does not find the gap there and it's straight to the point fielder
and almost an edge, it was a good length delivery and Marsh wants to play it without getting his foot out, is beaten, through to the keeper
short of length and he wants to cut it away, no pace on the ball and nothing on the shot
slower one, and Gilly goes back and taps it to wide mid-on for a single
and again, same length, same area, same result, the only thing different was the intent, this is deliberately played and it runs away to the fence for a four!
edged and beats the keeper through to the fence for a four! it was on a length and induces a genuine edge, the keeper had to dive to his left but was far from his reach
round the wicket and he bowls on his favourite good length, tries to play it through the line, but straight to fielder
slows it down even further and Gilly is back, pulling and through mid-wicket for a single
again an an attempt made to hit it down the ground but they aren't getting off the meat of the bat, hits it to mid-on for a single
goes down the track and tries to hit it in anger, does not get it off the middle and it gets to mid-on for a single
very full and flighted up to the bat, Gilly drives it to the cover fielder
shorter in length and tapped to the leg side for a single

blasted back to the fence but it's not timed too well and still goes to the fence, fuller in length but it came slower than what Gilly expected, he had gone through with the shot and hits the toe end of the bat, Sreesanth pulls his hand out of the way and it rolls down to the fence
short again but Gilly is no Marsh, he gets the pull away and it's off the middle of the bat, pulled away for a four
short ball, wants to pull it away but for the third time this over, the middle of the bat is missing, hits the top edge of the bat and lands at mid-wicket, there's no-one there and off for a single
that's thrown up wide outside the off stump and he does get some bat on it, but not off the middle yet again and it goes to the fielder
drilled through extra-cover for a four, that's very full and while it did not come off the middle of the bat, it's hit in the gap and rushes away
short of length and that's been cut away to the off side, straight to the fielder
wants to cut it away but straight to the fielder
tapped away to the leg side for a single

whoa, what happened there? that's tapped down to mid-on and it's thrown back, Gilly's been hit by the throw, and Chandila lifts up the ricochet and whips off the bails, Gilly is out of the crease, but Dravid takes the appeal back! Gilchrist was angry on that, very, very angry!
on his pads and that's tucked round to mid-wicket for a couple of runs by Marsh
floated it up to the bat from round the stumps and driven down to long-off for a single
outside the off stump and it's short enough to deserve a cut, he does that but it's hit straight to point where it's misfielded and they are off for a single
good shot from a man making his comeback, fuller outside the off and that's drilled through the extra-cover for a four, the first boundary of the day
it's on a length but Gilly loves to play 'em off the back foot and he does just that, defends it to the off side
slower one I thought but it's at 132 km/hr, fuller too and he's tapped it down to the mid-off fielder, they are off for a quick single
ooh, almost! it was on a good length but closer to the bat, he was confused whether to go forward or back and beats the outside edge, seemed to have nipped away too
length ball that's outside the off, he wants to play it on the up and hits it well, but there's a short cover in place, straight to him
outside the off stump and keeps it on a good length, that nips back a little but not at too much pace and he drives it to mid-off
that's floated up to the bat in an invite to drive him away, he does it well, straight to mid-off but with a bit of a fumble there allowing a single
fullish length but without any turn, on the middle stump and Marsh's driven it back to the bowler
again a slower one, shorter too and he's on the back foot, defending to the off side

gone, caught and bowled! it was fuller up to the bat and he was looking to drive it straight back, he managed to do it but fails to keep it down, a simple catch back to the bowler, one down for nothing.
another one that's slowed down considerably, wants to dab at it, no turn, in fact drift away from the batsman
flighted right up to the bat, on the off stump, tapped back to the bowler
game, set, match there, full, outside the off stump and that's hit as hard as you will see an 18-year old hit!
slower one outside the off stump, gets some bat on it and pushes it to the off side for a single, Marsh has a shy at the stumps and misses by some distance
that's very full and outside the off stump, can only dig it out back to the bowler
slower one on the middle stump, tapped away to the leg side for a single
outside the off and driven straight to the short cover fielder
short in length and he's pulled it in front of deep square-leg for a six, mighty, mighty six!
fuller on the middle and he hits hard down the ground for a single
on his pads, was looking to flick it away but gets the inside part of the pads and it runs away to third-man for a leg-bye
outside the off and he was looking to move around, bit of a lazy shot, misses, through to the keeper
moves around in his crease and then opens the face of the bat, bit of an edge that runs down to third-man for a single
pitches it very full and outside the off stump, he was looking to go outside the leg stump, gets some bat on it
goes down the track and wants to pull it away, gets an inside edge that rolls across for a single to the leg side
shot, shot, shot, that's some aggression, it was right up to the bat and he goes back, opens up his stance and cracks it over mid-wicket for a maximum!
short in length and he pulls it away to the leg side for a couple of runs to get to his third 50 in a row, well played, law of averages not working here!
yorker length delivery that jags back into him, manages to dig it out, hit to short mid-wicket
outside the off stump and he looks to open the face of the bat, not for runs
slower one and he was looking to thrash it at first but the pace change allows him to open the face of the bat and guides it to the off side for a single

what a delivery and what a shot! it was very full and he was looking to move around the crease before stopping and takes the ball off the middle-stump, opens the face of the bat and guides it through third-man for a four
bouncer attempted and the batsman goes under it, lets it go and hopes for a wide, it's not
goes down the track and drills it straight to mid-off where Hussey fields and gets the throw in, does not hit! Would have been out had it done!
on his pads, full-toss and easily tapped away through mid-wicket for a four
fuller on the middle stump, tapped to mid-on for a single
down the leg side and that's wides, Gilly fails to collect it too which adds to the total
now fuller and he backs away and hits it through the off yet again for a single
wow, power-packed punch through extra-cover, shorter in length and it's rushed away through the area for a couple
on his pads and tucked away to the leg side for a single
fuller on his pads and that's tipped away to long-on for a single
goes down again but this time it's not off the middle of the bat, runs over to wide long-on for a single
goes down the track and hit over the bowler for a four, finally gets going after that lull in proceedings
fuller again and defended to the short cover fielder
was looking to go down the track but then defends it to the off side
on his pads and that's quietly tucked away to the leg side for a single
very quick yet again, he taps it back to the bowler who fields it well
fuller on the leg stump and driven down the ground to long-on for a single
that quicker one again, outside the off stump and pushed to point
googly probably, he was looking to defend off the front foot, gets an inside edge to short fine-leg
that's fuller and spinning away from the batsman, he was looking to drive at it, but gets an outside edge
slows it down and he's on the back foot, taps it down the ground for a single
gets his bat and pad out and defends on the front foot
shorter this time and tapped to the short mid-wicket fielder who runs to his left and makes a good stop
fuller on the off stump, bit of turn away from the batsman and defended to the off side
in the air, that seemed to have stopped on the batsman as he was trying to drive it, gets it over short cover
floats it up on the off stump and driven down to long-off for a single
not pitching it right up to the bat, drives it to long-on for a single
on the length outside the off stump, tucks it away to the leg side for a single
short of length on the off stump and played away to the leg side for a single
slower one, shorter one and he waits for a million years before tapping it through the backward point for a four
on the off stump and he pushes it to the right of the bowler, who dives and takes the pace off it but what it also does is to push it beyond him and the long-on fielder, they come back for the second
very slow and short, easily pulled away to the leg side for a single
shorter in length and pulled away to deep square-leg for a single
shorter on length and again on his pads, easily tucked between fine-leg and deep square-leg and they run well to come back for the second
fuller on the middle and this time Rahane isn't quick on it, almost like he didn't expect it to be that full, still gets enough bat on it for a couple to fine-leg
digs it in short and outside the off stump, opens the face of the bat and guides it through to third-man for a single
fuller on the middle, bit of a reverse back and easily flicked away through mid-wicket for a single
gets it on the middle stump now and tapped away to the leg side
and this is even wider down the leg side from the bowler, easily left alone and equally easy for the ump to call a wide
on his pads and wants to flick it away, any bat on that would have given him aplenty, instead, he misses and that's called a wide
very short from the bowler, slower too and crunches it through the covers for a single
shorter in length and punched it through the covers for a single

bowled him, whoa, that was a Afridi in disguise! it was bowled at 117 km/hr, Watson wasn't expecting it at all, he saw it short and went for the pull, by the time he had gone back, the ball had also sneaked through and hit the timber
slows it down this time, opens the face of the bat and guides it to short third-man for a single
shorter in length and it's cut away through the covers for a single
poor delivery, Chawla does this quite often, shorter, quicker and Watson easily swivels around and pulls it away hard, much harder than the hardest Rahane would ever hit!
goes down the track and times it over long-off for a six! Rahane does not hit them too hard but his timing is enough to get them just over the ropes, he seems to be choosing the gaps well too!
slower, fuller and he defends it right under his eye, back to the bowler
he's definitely getting some movement here, but easily played through point for a couple of runs, the third-man had to come around to stop it
on a good length outside the off stump, bit of movement away from the bat too and he opens the face of the bat through to third-man for a single
shorter in length and he was looking to pull it away, almost like the ball did not come on to the bat, pulls it to deep square-leg for a single
short of length, outside the off stump and defended to the off side
slightly shorter and he's quickly back and taps to the leg side for a single
defended off the front foot and to the off side, not for runs this time
up and over extra-cover for a six! there wasn't any pace on the ball and he had make all the pace off it, he times it beautifully and gets maximum!
shorter in length and that's an attempted googly, pulled away to the leg side for a single
fuller this time and on the middle stump, defended back to the bowler
shorter in length and easily tapped to the short cover fielder
slightly shorter in length and pushed down to the leg side for a single
slightly shorter in length, pushes it to long-on for a single
fuller from the bowler and on the middle stump, driven to the off side, straight to the fielder
very short this time, after a couple of good ones, he tries to pull it away but gets a bit of a top edge and goes over to deep square-leg for a single
doesn't hesitate to toss it up, driven to mid-wicket but straight to the fielder
shot sir, that's almost like he was lining up to hit it over and he does just that, fuller on the off stump, flighted too and tonk it goes, over long-off for a six
full-toss and on the middle stump, flicked it away to the leg side for a single
slower ball and on the middle stump, tucked away to fine-leg for a single
short of a good length and punches straight to the fielder in the circle on the off side
slows it down, pushes it to mid-off and off for a quick single, Hussey was quick to it and throws at the non-striker's end but misses, Watson was quick too and seemed to be home even if he had hit

cracked away through the off side for a four, there was a little width on that one and he makes the bowler pay, there were four fielders in the area between point to mid-off but he pierces them easily
slows it down and it's on the off stump, punches it back to mid-on, hit hard enough to not allow them a single
and this is the turn of Rahane to repeat the dose, it was outside the off stump, short of length and Rahane stands tall and crunches it through cover for a four
and now over the leg side, was fuller and he muscles it over the in-field but does not get too much power and goes to the fielder there
whoa, classic, on a good length and outside the off stump, he gets some width too and the batsman's hit it through the line and through extra-cover for a four
he wanted to pull it away there and he gets only a top edge on that one, falls short of the third-man fielder, survives
short of length for Watson who's able to flick it away to the leg side for a single
outside the off stump and on a good length, pushes it to the off side
this time he gets a four, that was short, his third one of the over but he hits it straighter this time, goes through to wide long-on area for a four
very short again and he's gone back and pulled it straight to long-on for a single
fuller on the off stump for a change and Watson's driven it crisply, but straight to the extra-cover fielder, done well by Mandeep Singh
another one that's quite short and slow, gets enough time to pull it but goes straight to the deep mid-wicket fielder for a single
shorter in length and hes quickly on to it, pulls it into the gap at mid-wicket and gets himself a single
shorter in length and he wants to tap it away, gets it away to the deep cover fielder for a single
this is on a good length and he was looking to run it down to the third-man, misses the outside edge, beaten by some movement away from the wicket
short of length on the off stump and the push gets an inside edge through to the leg side for a single
very full for a change and he's got to dig it out, does that well and drives it back to the bowler
short of length and punched into the covers this time, straight to the fielder

short of length, mere push and tell you what, it's run away to the fence! it was hit straight and for a while it looked like the mid-on fielder will easily save it, he doesn't nor the does the chasing mid-off and it goes away!
shortish in length but close to the off stump, still manages to cut it away to third-man for a single
on his pads this time and he gets it off the middle of the bat while sweeping it to short fine-leg, but it goes far too quickly to the fielder for them to think runs
fullish from the bowler and Rahane gets his bat and pad out, defends it to the off side again
slows it down and it's on the off stump, pushes it to the off side
fuller on the off stump and driven it down the ground for a single

bowled him, what a ball! in fact, it was a good ball not the best of shots from the captain, it dipped into him, was on the middle and he was looking to flick it away, he gets no bat on it and it sneaks between his bat and pad, timber
fuller on the middle and that's driven to the leg side for a single
short of length outside the off stump and punched down to mid-off, just one scoring shot in the over
bit closer to the stumps now, corrects the line and he's tucked away to the square-leg, rolls over to the close-in fielder
and this one bounces a little too much for the batsman, swing away too and beats the outside edge of the cut
shorter in length and does not bounce too high, pushed into the covers
outside the off stump, swinging away from the batsman and that's cut through the covers for a four, not hit too hard but placed extremely well
fuller on the off stump, bit of dip back into the batsman who drives it back to the bowler
